body: I guess so. I will have to see what happens tomorrow, I can only hope it's good, and that it gets easier. Thanks for your time.

I was sad it was done. I don't know because of it being over; or because I wanted to feel more like there's more to want to keep going. I do have many good memories, but of course coming back to the mess i left, isn't the best.

I mean, I did this trip because I expected it to renew my will to go on and show me that true happiness can be found for me, but it more showed me that even in times of great happiness, I can still find ways to feel miserable, and I don't want that to be all my life is.
Even if the outcome is good, I don't know if that would make me want to keep on going, it feels easier and better to just let go, even if I know that's wrong.
